credits.title: The Secret Recipe
credits.overview: When a gifted chef loses his sharp sense of taste, he turns to an old friend who helps him rediscover traditional flavors through an old recipe book.

credits.title: Harlot's Prayer
credits.overview: Kiran, a Muslim woman, loses her faith and falls into promiscuity after a hard-line Islamic organization, meant to strengthen her faith, ends up depriving her of it.

credits.title: Trinil
credits.overview: Returning home after their honeymoon, a couple find themselves haunted by a disembodied head seeking its missing body.

credits.title: Teori Cakrawala
credits.overview: A young teacher named Cakrawala who will teach in the Jember area. The teacher with a conventional teaching style then met a young man who had graduated from a master's degree. As a result of the conflict between the two, Cakrawala finally finds a different teaching method, so they fall in love with each other.

credits.title: Jeritan Malam
credits.overview: Reza and his three friends tried to explore the history of the dorm they lived. But unfortunately, Reza does a ritual that should not have been done.

credits.title: The Robbers
credits.overview: When an aging king must choose an immediate successor, his decision divides two brothers and fills a kingdom with chaos, violence and betrayal.
